scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=apps/web && npm run build --workspace=apps/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/web && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/api
scripts.db:migrate: tsx apps/api/prisma/verify-database.ts migrate && prisma migrate deploy --config apps/api/prisma.config.ts
scripts.db:seed: tsx apps/api/prisma/verify-database.ts seed && prisma db seed --config apps/api/prisma.config.ts
scripts.db:test:migrate: tsx apps/api/prisma/verify-database.ts test-migrate && prisma migrate deploy --config apps/api/prisma.test.config.ts
scripts.db:grants: tsx apps/api/prisma/verify-database.ts grants && tsx apps/api/prisma/verify-database.ts test-grants && tsx apps/api/prisma/apply-database-grants.ts
